<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 8"
    pfs="Limited"
>
[Statue](/Feats.aspx?ID=4382) <actions string="Single Action" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Archetype" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=12" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Pathfinder #195: Heavy is the Crown](/Sources.aspx?ID=210) pg. 83

**Archetype** [Stonebound](/Archetypes.aspx?ID=210)

**Prerequisites**
[Stonebound Dedication](/Feats.aspx?ID=4377)

</column>

---

Your body and equipment appear to be made of stone as you hold perfectly still. Until the next time you act, you appear to be a statue and do not need to eat, drink, or breathe, but you are [flat-footed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=16). Your [Deception](/Skills.aspx?ID=5) DC to pass as a statue is equal to 10 + your proficiency bonus (do not apply any other bonuses, penalties, or modifiers).
